network_scope: Current official public documentation only; no token, provider data API, production host, production config, publication, or CURRENT switch.

catalog_policy.reason: The file is the immutable 263-page acquisition snapshot. Current off-catalog documents remain enumerated in config/tushare-coverage-ledger.json and become executable through reviewed registry overlays; rewriting the frozen source snapshot would falsify its provenance.

official_documents.contract_fact: freq and ts_code required; five uppercase minute frequencies; multiple stock codes allowed; eight output fields; 1000 rows per call.

rt_etf_min accepts one or multiple ETF codes and has a 1000-row limit; the separately named daily endpoint accepts one ETF and replays current opening-to-now. The page does not establish that the sibling row cap applies to daily.
item is required; date/start_date/end_date are legal filters; date,item,op_income are documented outputs; each request is limited to 30 months; current product table enumerates codes 1 through 65.
date/item/symbol/start_date/end_date/source are optional; five outputs include default-hidden consop_income; company and product lists have no effective dates.

retained_provider_evidence.meaning: API name rejected; this is not permission or permanent-removal proof.

planning.rt_min: Explicit realtime_extra activation, explicit current UTC snapshot epoch, actual stored stock discovery, one or more codes, five exact frequencies.
planning.rt_etf_min: Explicit realtime_extra activation, explicit current UTC snapshot epoch, actual stored ETF discovery, one or more codes, five exact frequencies.
planning.rt_etf_min_daily: Explicit realtime_replay activation, explicit current UTC snapshot epoch, one actual stored ETF per request, current opening-to-now only, five exact frequencies.

planning.tmt_twincomedetail: Explicit offcatalog_apis selection; prior/current month for each documented product 1..65; optional history is monthly per product. Current company labels are not used as PIT fanout.

invariants: No execution-price forward fill or missing-bar-to-suspension inference.
Request epoch and observation time do not replace supplier time or point-in-time availability.
Current stock, ETF, product and company lists do not prove historical membership or completeness.
Empty, below-cap and terminal saturated responses remain distinct from complete coverage.
No unit conversion is inferred where the current page omits currency or scale.
